finding: Paired comparisons need identical folds; E-SCREEN has only 152 positives in total
evidence_value: 4584 training / 1146 hold-out; 5x5 folds stratified by the 3x3 strata; min 25 E-SCREEN positives per fold
decision: Hold-out (label x race) created once and not evaluated in S7; repeated stratified folds on the training part stratified by stratum_3x3, stored with hash and shared by all arms
alternatives_rejected: Stratify folds on L_comb only (uneven undiagnosed counts per fold); new folds per arm
check_note: fold hash verified on every run; OOF file asserts no hold-out SEQN

finding: Age, BMI, HDL and TC bend significantly; interactions not detected; strong anthropometric collinearity
evidence_value: RCS chi2 age 57.6, BMI 11.6, HDL 18.5, TC 41.8; race x BMI p 0.39; EPV 18.5 (T1)
decision: Main model L2 logistic regression with B-spline terms; depth-3 tree (min leaf 50) only as threshold/leakage probe; no interaction terms
alternatives_rejected: GAM/boosting (HR3); categorised bands; L1 selection; interaction terms

finding: S4 finds sex x BMI significant in one of three specifications
decision: No sex x BMI term (specification-dependent evidence); listed as a limitation for S10
alternatives_rejected: Add sex x BMI (would be data-dredged after the lock)

finding: HR2 requires the same model for minimal and systematic arms
decision: C0 chosen once by LogisticRegressionCV on S (Tier 1) and frozen for every arm; optimistic bias towards S disclosed; M0 own-C sensitivity in S9
alternatives_rejected: Tune C per arm (breaks the paired same-model design)
check_note: inner-CV AUC nearly flat across C

finding: Locked verdict rules need a mechanical implementation
decision: E-ALL: wider of Nadeau-Bengio corrected t and paired stratified bootstrap; E-SCREEN: bootstrap; MDD reported; for directional claims an evalkit 'equivalent' (CI inside +-magnitude) is recorded as refuted
alternatives_rejected: Naive t-test over folds (ignores overlap); fold-level AUC on E-SCREEN (about 25 positives)

finding: ADA risk test lacks family history and gestational diabetes in 2021-23
evidence_value: S - ADA-lite on E-SCREEN +0.055 [+0.026, +0.083]; ADA missing answers {'ada_htn_missing': 4, 'ada_inactive_missing': 39, 'ada_bmi_missing': 62}
decision: Reduced ADA-lite (age, sex, hypertension, inactivity, BMI points; missing answers 0 points) compared by AUC and recall at specificity 0.80 only; published cut-off not used
alternatives_rejected: Use the published cut-off >= 5 (invalid with 2 items missing)
check_note: BL0 AUC 0.500 in every fold asserted

finding: The naive arm's discrimination is leakage
decision: M1 (availability rule) is the honest minimal arm; the drop is reported as a correct deterioration (HR4)
alternatives_rejected: Report M0 as the minimal arm (would present leakage as performance)
check_note: H2a supported, B2 supported, B2t supported

evidence_value: S Tier 1 AUC E-ALL 0.836 vs E-SCREEN 0.781; gap +0.055 [+0.028, +0.086]
decision: Report E-ALL and E-SCREEN side by side for every arm; E-SCREEN is the screening claim

finding: Care-contact items help to recognise known patients but not to screen
decision: Carry T1-minus-care to S8/S9 as the screening-oriented variant; H2c(ii) E-SCREEN sub-claim reported as inconclusive under the locked rule although the CI excludes 0
alternatives_rejected: Silently switch the main arm to T1-minus-care (post hoc)

finding: Balanced class weights distort probabilities without changing ranking
evidence_value: B6a Brier +0.0757 [+0.0679, +0.0836] -> supported; balanced accuracy at 0.5 +0.1448 [+0.1234, +0.1663] -> supported
decision: Keep S as locked (includes P11) and report S-B6a calibration; recommend an explicit threshold instead of class weights for deployment (S10)
alternatives_rejected: Drop P11 from S after seeing results (post hoc)
check_note: B6a supported; H2b inconclusive because of Brier

finding: Redundancy pruning stabilises BMI strongly in unscaled fits, moderately inside the scaled L2 pipeline; the sign-flip criterion is dominated by a near-zero height coefficient
decision: Report B3 as locked (mixed) with the mechanism; no re-definition of the sign-flip metric after the lock
alternatives_rejected: Exclude height from the flip criterion post hoc

finding: S4 DAJ suggests dropping weight, height, hip and arm a priori; the locked S6 design uses in-fold VIF > 10
decision: Keep the locked S6 rule; difference stated in section 2 and communicated to survey-eda

finding: S8 and S9 need predictions without refitting
decision: Persist OOF predictions (SEQN, repeat, fold, arm, tier, model, prob, L_comb, L_self, L_A1c, y_escreen, in_escreen, stratum_3x3, row) and metrics_S7.json
